services.desc: Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and Holidays ONLY (see schedule below) 10 a.m.-6 p.m. Rentals stop at 5 p.m. All rentals are FREE for 2 hours, and require a valid photo ID to rent. All rentals are on a first-come, first-served basis and cannot be reserved in advance. Life vests and paddles are provided. Customers must be at least 18 years of age, or 16 years of age accompanied by a parent or guardian on the water. As a reminder, visitors are always welcome to launch their own boats at locations indicated in the park. See the “Public Boat Launching” section below. blurb: Lake Crabtree County Park is located in western Wake County and features gardens, picnic shelters, restrooms, playgrounds, hiking and walking trails, fishing, educational programs, bicycling, mountain biking, boating, and volleyball. The park offers boat rentals and a paddling trail. It is open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset, with some holiday closures and possible closures for special events or weather.
extraNote: The park is subject to closure during special events, inclement weather and for natural recovery. · The park is closed Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and New Years Day.
